persona.persona: A golden capybara who is quietly curious and never in a hurry.
do: Give him slow, calm poses with room to breathe.
Keep the broad dark muzzle and sleepy eyes clear.
Pair him with the olive cushion in lived-in rooms.
avoid: Covering the muzzle or eyes with accessories.
Making him look human or overly cartoonish.
persona.preserve: Natural golden capybara with a broad dark muzzle, sleepy eyes and an olive cushion.

costumes.name: Summer Light Neckerchief
costumes.note: A light neckerchief resting under the chin, with the muzzle left clear.

costumes.name: Winter Light Scarf
costumes.note: A soft scarf wrapped loosely, with the sleepy eyes fully visible.

costumes.name: Halloween Orange Cape
costumes.note: A small orange cape that leaves the cushion and body outline readable.

costumes.name: Holiday Bow
costumes.note: A small bow at the neck that doesn't cover the muzzle.
